Claude settings to change first: 5 memory and privacy controls to check on day one, from instructions to import.

5 Claude settings to change before your next chat. Memory and privacy, in order.

1. Instructions - Add account-wide tone, length, and format rules.
2. Memory - Open Settings, then Memory; edit or delete anything.
3. Sensitive - Sensitive topics stay out of memory unless enabled.
4. Pause - Pause memory, or turn it off for one chat.
5. Import - Bring memory from another AI with Start import.

Needs: Free, Pro, Max
